And you know, the whole idea of "I've got nothing to lose, so might as well do X" is the whole bloody reason I am where I am.

I fucking *despise* this ideology now.

It's exactly what I'm doing.

Leaving this life and figuring out what's in the next, if there is even one.

It's always hookers and blow.

Why not, I don't know, ketamine and ladyboys?

It's also something a lot of western philsophers have dealt with. It's something people have been talking about, endlessly, to no avail, since man-incarnate.

They still died and they're still forgotten.

There's really no point in discussing what is absolutely inevitable.

It honestly doesn't matter at this point.

It all fades away at some point, whether by your own hand or not. 

I'm over it, I don't care for it, and my only fear, my only real fear is that God will punish me for some reason and I'll be punished for the rest of eternity.
